extension.description: Task boards in VS Code for Obsidian Kanban and Backlog.md.
config.kanban.saveOnEdit: Save the file right after each board change, so Obsidian and other tools see it immediately. When off, changes stay unsaved like normal edits.
config.kanban.doneLanes: Lane names that count as done lanes even without a **Complete** line (exact match). Cards moved into them are checked, cards moved out are unchecked.
config.kanban.openBoardsByDefault: Reopen Markdown files whose frontmatter has a kanban-plugin key as a board.
config.kanban.rememberBoards: Remember each file shown as a board in the user setting workbench.editorAssociations, so VS Code opens it as a board directly (no extra text tab from the explorer). Open as Text removes the entry; turning this off removes all entries Notewell added.
config.kanban.style: How boards look. High contrast themes always use the VS Code style.
config.kanban.style.obsidian: Use the vault's Obsidian theme colors (theme, enabled snippets, light/dark mode and accent color). Files outside a vault use the VS Code style.
config.kanban.style.notewell: Use Notewell's own palette; light or dark follows the brightness of the VS Code theme.
config.kanban.style.vscode: Follow the current VS Code theme.
config.kanban.cardBodies: How card bodies (the indented lines under a card) are shown when a board opens. Folding a card on the board or with the Collapse/Expand All Card Bodies commands changes only the view, never the file.
config.kanban.cardBodies.collapsed: Fold card bodies to a one-line marker.
config.kanban.cardPreview: Show the whole card rendered as Markdown in a popup when the pointer rests on a folded card (or with Ctrl+K Ctrl+I on a selected card with a body).
config.backlog.enabled: Enable the Backlog.md task board feature (shown only in workspaces with a Backlog.md project).
config.backlog.saveOnEdit: Save task files right after a change made in the Backlog panel.
config.backlog.detailPosition: Where the Backlog panel shows task details.
config.backlog.detailPosition.bottom: Below the board or list (good for narrow screens).
config.backlog.detailPosition.right: To the right of the board or list.
config.backlog.projects: Backlog.md folders (the folders with config.yml) to use in addition to the ones found at workspace folder roots. Relative to the workspace folder, or absolute. Task and document paths are relative to each folder’s parent.
config.attachments.enabled: Paste or drop images and files into vault notes as Obsidian attachments.
config.attachments.folder: Folder for new attachments, overriding Obsidian's attachment folder setting (same syntax: "/" vault root, "./" the note's folder, "./name" a subfolder, or a vault folder). Empty follows Obsidian.
config.backlinks.unlinked: Also list unlinked mentions: places where the note name appears without a link (slower in large vaults).
config.links.enabled: Update links in Obsidian vaults when files are renamed or moved in VS Code.
config.links.updateOnRename: When a file in a vault is renamed or moved, update the links to it.
config.links.updateOnRename.obsidian: Update the links. VS Code shows its own confirmation of the changes first, as Obsidian asks by default.
config.links.updateOnRename.always: Update the links (VS Code may still show its own confirmation).
config.links.updateOnRename.prompt: Also ask in a Notewell dialog each time.
config.links.saveUpdatedFiles: Save the files whose links were updated, if they had no unsaved changes before. Off: updated files stay unsaved so you can review them.
config.linkPreview.enabled: Show a preview when hovering a link in a vault note, and go to the linked note (heading or block) with Ctrl+click.
config.canvas.enabled: Enable the canvas view for JSON Canvas (.canvas) files. When off, .canvas files open as text.
config.canvas.editable: Allow moving, resizing, recoloring and editing text cards in the canvas view. When off, canvases are shown read-only.
config.canvas.snapToGrid: Moved and resized cards land on a 20 px grid.
config.links.createMissingNotes: What Ctrl+click on a wikilink to a missing note does: ask before creating the note where Obsidian puts new notes, or never create one.
config.links.createMissingNotes.ask: Ask, then create an empty note (Obsidian setting "Default location for new notes", or the folder written in the link).
config.dailyNotes.enabled: Daily note commands, following the Obsidian Daily notes settings (folder, date format, template).
config.dailyNotes.dateLanguage: Language of month and weekday names in daily note names and template dates (`MMMM`, `dddd`, `Do`, `A`). Set it to the language of your Obsidian app, which Notewell cannot read from the vault.
config.dailyNotes.dateLanguage.auto: The VS Code display language (Korean if VS Code is in Korean, otherwise English).
config.templates.enabled: Template commands, following the Obsidian Templates settings (folder, date and time formats).
